Application Data.NAME: PrintWorks Inc.
Application Data.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS: PrintWorks Inc. specializes in providing high-quality printing and copying services, including digital printing, large format printing, and document copying. We cater to both individual customers and small businesses, offering tailored solutions that cater to specific needs, while ensuring compliance with safety protocols for the handling of inks and materials. Our facility maintains a well-organized workspace to control customer traffic and minimize risks associated with theft and property damage. Additionally, we do not engage in online sales or high-risk operations, focusing instead on in-store services to mitigate exposure.

Application Data.DESCRIPTION OF LOSSES: On March 15, 2023, a minor fire occurred in the production area due to an electrical malfunction, resulting in damage to equipment and materials. The estimated loss was $4,500. The fire was contained quickly with no injuries reported, and all damages have been repaired. The incident was reported to the insurance provider, and the claim is currently closed.
